posts.author: Heirukichi
posts.body:
From what I can see, it looks pretty much like the standard VX Ace RTP (or an edit of it). As such, you can only use it in RPG Maker games and only if you own the license (as far as I remember).
I am not a lawyer and I am going by heart here, so check VX Ace RTP license to make sure, but it should be pretty much as I described.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
johnythepvpgod said:
which is a non-copyrighted spritesheet
Click to expand...
OK, let's start explaining where you went wrong.
EVERY artwork has a copyright, and it belongs to all artists that ever worked on that piece.
There are just a number of cases where the artists give free licence to use their work.
To have a licence to use something, you need to get that licence from everyone who worked on it, even if they only did a minor edit or rearranging of the tiles. If there is even one person who doesn't give that licence, then you cannot use that piece without risking being called out on it.
And you can only check for that licence if you have the names/credits for everyone who worked on something. So if something is from a website that doesn't track all credits then you should not use it.
For all RTP/Stock resources for all makers the rule is that you get a licence to use and edit their RTP/Stock resources when you purchase a specific maker.
So to use RTP-like Tileset Edits, you first need to know which exact maker the originals came from (to check if you own that one or have to purchase it before using) as well as the person(s) who made the edits, to see if they gave a free licence (no one has a licence to sell RTP-Edits).
Originally all RTP Licences contained a limit to allow usage only in other RPG-Makers you own. That restriction was at least partially removed a while ago by GGG, but I haven't bothered to read the new licence yet because I didn't need it.
But you would have to check it to learn if the included tilesets could be used in the specific engine you want to use, and then purchase the maker that included the tilesets you want to use (which can be very cheap on steam resales, VXA is often below 10$ in such sales)

posts.author: Nenen
posts.body:
While I don't know where YOU found these images, using info from the images themselves (the wordpress website) I found the original source of these particular images.
Download package for all “Complete” RPG Maker VX Tileset Edits
This package consists of 8 Tilests for RPG Maker VX Ace to be used as B-D. The goal was to rearrange the content from the standard RTP tilesets to have as many elements as possible without duplicat…
thestoryteller01.wordpress.com
Like the others told you already, these are (official) RTP assets (for VX ACE in this case), merely rearranged with the goal of removing duplicate stuff apparently
-
You must own VX/Ace to use them, and they automatically come with the engine.
I also want to repeat what Ander said, "
EVERY artwork has a copyright
, and it belongs to all artists that ever worked on that piece." and this includes Mack/Refmap/FSM's stuff.
And note what the source site actually says about what you posted about:
All credit for the artwork goes to Enterbrain. Feel free to use the tilesets for your RPG Maker projects but please don’t use this content without proper crediting.
Click to expand...
And yes,
Until recently
the ToS for these assets
was
restricted to RM engines only, but that was changed with Unite so
as long as you legally own the particular engine the assets come from
, you can use them in any other engine.
